Date December 5, 1940.
Subject A.A. Nogaitseff.
Made by. D.J.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J.I. Crawford.

Andrey Andreyevich NOGAITSEFF,Russian,born on
13-10-1902 at St.Petersburg,Russia. He is reported to have
arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok in October,1922
aboard the s.s. "Hsipingan" and to have since been resid-
ing in this city. He had no regular employment here,but
is known to have worked for various periods with certain
local Russian and English newspapers as a reporter.
In 1934-1936 he was the editor of "ARGUS",a
bilingual magazine. This magazine was subsidized by cer-
tain parties for the purpose of counter-acting the noisy
campaign which was at that time conducted against various
local institutions in the "Shanghai Spectator" by the no-
torious W.A. Beaumont-Izrailevich. Following Beaumont's
hurried departure from Shanghai in 1936 the subsidy was
withdrawn. Nogaitseff tried to carry on his "independent
social and political publication",but without success,
and the magazine went out of existence during the same
year.
In 1937-1938 he was employed as a foreman with
the Asiatic Petroleum Company during the period when Rus-
sian labour was required by the company.
From June,1938 to August,1939 he was connected
with the "Evening Echo". It appears that,as a result of
some dissension over financial matters,Nogaitseff decided
to start his own newspaper of the same type under the name
"Shanghai Echo". A certain A.W. Summers,British,who is at
at Hongkong at present,was to be Chief Editor,while Nogai-
tseff was supposed to look after the financial side of the

安德烈·安德烈耶维奇·诺盖采夫（Andrey Andreyevich NOGAITSEFF），俄国人，1902年10月13日出生于俄国圣彼得堡。据报他于1922年10月乘坐“Hsipingan”号轮船从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海，并自此居住在本市。他在本市没有固定职业，但已知曾断断续续为某些本地俄文和英文报纸担任记者。

1934年至1936年间，他是双语杂志《ARGUS》（观察家）的编辑。该杂志由某些方面提供资助，旨在对抗当时臭名昭著的 W.A. Beaumont-Izrailevich 在《Shanghai Spectator》（上海观察家报）上针对本地各机构进行的喧闹宣传运动。随着 Beaumont 于1936年匆忙离开上海，资助被撤回。Nogaitseff 试图继续维持其“独立的社会和政治出版物”，但未获成功，该杂志于同年停刊。

1937年至1938年间，在亚细亚火油公司需要俄国劳工期间，他被该公司雇佣为工头。

1938年6月至1939年8月，他与《Evening Echo》（晚声报）有关联。看来由于在财务问题上发生了一些分歧，Nogaitseff 决定创办一份同类型的报纸，名为《Shanghai Echo》（上海回声报）。一位名叫 A.W. Summers 的英国人（目前在香港）将担任主编，而 Nogaitseff 则负责该企业的财务方面事务。

Subject A.A. Nogaitseff.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by Supt. J. Mason.

Andrey Andreyevich NOGAITSEFF, Russian, born on
13-10-1902 at St. Petersburg, Russia. He is reported to
have arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok in October, 1922
aboard the s.s. "Hsipingan" and to have since been resid-
ing in this city. He had no regular employment here, but
is known to have worked for various periods with certain
local Russian and English newspapers as a reporter.

In 1934-1936 he was the editor of "ARGUS", a
bilingual magazine. This magazine was subsidized by certain
parties for the purpose of counter-acting the noisy cam-
paign which was at that time conducted against various lo-
cal institutions in the "Shanghai Spectator" by the noto-
rious W.A. Beaumont-Izrailevich. Following Beaumont's hur-
ried departure from Shanghai in 1936 the subsidy was with-
drawn. Nogaitseff tried to carry on his "independent so-
cial and political publication", but without success, and
the magazine went out of existence during the same year.

In 1937 -1938 he was employed as a foreman with
the Asiatic Petroleum Company during the period when Rus-
sian labour was required by the company.

From June, 1938 to August, 1939 he was connected
with the "Evening Echo". It appears that as a result of
some dissension over financial matters, Nogaitseff decided
to start his own newspaper of the same type under the name
"Shanghai Echo". A certain A.W. Summers, British, who is at
Hongkong at present, was to be Chief Editor, while Nogaitseff
was supposed to look after the financial side of the enter-
prise . However, registration of this newspaper was not ap-

1934年至1936年间，他是双语杂志《ARGUS》（观察家）的编辑。该杂志由某些方面提供资助，旨在对抗当时臭名昭著的 W.A. Beaumont-Izrailevich 在《Shanghai Spectator》（上海观察家报）上针对本地各机构进行的喧闹宣传运动。随着 Beaumont 于1936年匆忙离开上海，资助被撤回。Nogaitseff 试图继续维持其“独立的社会和政治出版物”，但未获成功，该杂志于同年停刊。

1937年至1938年间，在亚细亚火油公司需要俄国劳工期间，他被该公司雇佣为工头。

1939年5月，他因涉嫌企图贿赂《字林西报》（North China Daily News）的一名工作人员，以便代表某一方获取关于一封致编辑信件的作者身份的信息（该信件主题涉及“盖世太保”的活动），而进入本办公室的视线。

SECRET
March 9th, 1940.

I should be grateful for a report on Captain
A. NOGAYTSEW and the Shanghai Business Service,
Room 35, 119 Jinkes Road. I understand that there
are indications in this office of connection with
the drug traffic and I further understand that
Nogaytsew's reputation locally is an indifferent
one. I should be most grateful if this matter
could be regarded as urgent.

"Y"

PA
Early please
R.O.I.

1940年3月9日。

恳请提供关于A·诺盖采夫上尉（Captain A. NOGAYTSEW）及位于金基路119号35室的“上海商业服务社”的报告。我获悉本办公室有迹象显示其与毒品贩运有关联，此外我还了解到诺盖采夫在当地的声誉不佳。如能将此事视为紧急事项处理，我将不胜感激。
